response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), type_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(tradekind, 'Missing') AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM linked GROUP BY COALESCE(tradekind, 'Missing')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts), with_share AS (SELECT tc.trader_type, tc.transaction_count, CAST(tc.transaction_count AS NUMERIC) / t.total_count AS share FROM type_counts tc, totals t), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM with_share) SELECT ws.trader_type, ws.transaction_count, ws.share, ws.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM with_share ws, avg_calc a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND ws.share > a.avg_share
